question: On Ordering the Previous Question — Providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 7148) the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026; providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 7147) the Department of Homeland Security Appropriations Act, 2026; and for other purposes (H RES 1014)
bill_title: Providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 7148) making further consolidated appropriations for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026, and for other purposes; providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 7147) making further consolidated appropriations for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026, and for other purposes; and for other purposes.
plain_language: This procedural vote is on the rule for H.R. 7148 (Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026) and H.R. 7147, not on those measures themselves. A Yea ends debate and forces a vote on the rule. A Nay tries to keep that debate open, which would let the minority offer a different plan. These votes usually split along party lines.
